per_candidate.id: s2:C/O Ratio Studies in the atmosphere of hot Jupiters
s2:Prediction of Sulfate Hazes in the Lower Venus Atmosphere

rationale: Paper 2204.03545 contributes substantive new evidence by applying a 3D model to study cloud and thermal phase curves in exoplanet atmospheres, which is relevant to comparing 1D and 3D modeling approaches. However, it does not fully settle the question across different modeling approaches.
